essence: Bhavani protects the devotee in the home and grants all sovereignty.
The goddess's protection extends across intellectual, martial, and perilous natural situations.
The terrible Durga protects the devotee in the fearsome abode of ghosts and spirits.
The greatness of the kavaca is beyond full description even in a hundred years.
The armor's protection encompasses family, all places, and all times.
